viewing_check: Confirm species: smell (Huon pine has a strong sweet oil scent), fine tight grain, pale yellow; check cut end for growth rings. Measure length, width and thickness of both slabs (is the second 1126 slab present and similar?). Note splits, rot and staining. Celery-top or other pine is worth far less.
